items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: Gus called us in the room. He says, 'Well, Gentlemen,' he says, 'I'm breaking up the band.'

ctx.x: Yeah. He was a terrific drummer, man. Lou Singer, man. And, those were my hang out guys. And, anyway, finally, after the Hotel New Yorker, well, Gus called us in the room. He says, "Well, Gentlemen," he says, "I'm breaking up the band." He says, "Because I'm kind of getting tired of travelling." He was a very wealthy man. He was a millionaire.
